policy.reason: Preserve upstream licensing and provenance. Project Jennifer stores pinned source references and derives its own controls instead of vendoring full OWASP documents into the MIT repository.
policy.refreshRule: A newer upstream revision does not silently replace this baseline. Re-pin through review and record the new commit hash.
